As a fan of the Legend of Heroes series, it pisses me off that Falcom still refuses to release an official English translation of the game in the West. Luckily, some fans who were more dedicated than I, created an English fan translation of the game and patched it to the Jap-only PC version, along with full voice acting from the PSVita's Evolution release.

Getting it working, however, was a bit of headache, due to how the "hack" was implemented to apply the English subtitles and voice acting. The steps are easy, but finding them out was a bitch, so here they are, in case you, too, are a fan of this series and want to play the game without having to use Windows.

Note: As there is no official release of this game, the only way to obtain this version is to pirate it. It sucks, but if a company will not provide a product, a means will appear to fill that lack. I won't link it here, but there are torrents and even a few websites still up where you can download the iso directly so, enjoy.

WINEARCH = 32bit

WINEVERSION = 4.4-Staging (this is an old game, so older versions of Wine will most likely work as well)

DLLOVERRIDES = dinput8 (native,builtin)

VARIABLES = LC_ALL = ja_JP.UTF-8

And that's it. Told you it was simple. The dinput8 override is essential, as this is how the patch it "hooked" into the game it make it's changes. Without it, the characters will not be voiced and they'll just spit out a bunch of gibberish in the text bubbles.
